outcome: fetal complications (fetal distress, respiratory distress syndrome, neonatal death)
cohort: Patients admitted to a private hospital in the UAE between 2015 and 2019 for vaginal delivery after one uncomplicated cesarean section (n=672).
finding: The VBAC success rate was 31%, with success more likely in patients aged 25-29 with cervical dilation >4cm and lower head station.
